queries_run: BKNG Booking Holdings antitrust OR monopoly investigation 2026
Booking Holdings regulation OR regulatory scrutiny Travel Services 2026
BKNG Booking Holdings DOJ OR FTC OR EU competition 2026

findings.claim: 10-K FY2025 揭露 Booking.com 受各國競爭主管機關調查（合約平價、定價工具、排名標準），已以承諾改變平價、排名資訊與價格顯示做法了結部分案件；並因 DMA gatekeeper／DSA VLOP 指定而受額外規範，已依 DMA 取消歐洲經濟區平價條款
findings.excerpt: We have been the subject of investigations or inquiries by national competition authorities ("Competition Authorities") and other governmental authorities regarding competition law matters, consumer protection issues, and other areas.

findings.claim: 2026 年 7 月 FTC 幕僚告知 Priceline 擬建議提起訴訟（揭露、費用、帳單等不公平或欺騙性做法，屬消費者保護而非反壟斷）；公司於 Q3 2026 認列營收減項 9 億美元及應計損失 1 億美元，尚未和解
findings.excerpt: FTC staff informed Priceline that they intend to recommend that the FTC files a complaint against Priceline and a business-to-business affiliate partner of Priceline asserting unfair or deceptive business practices related to disclosures, fees, customer support, and billing practices.

findings.claim: 西班牙 CNMC 2024 年裁罰並限制平價條款與排名標準；公司已入帳負債 4.76 億美元，西班牙國家法院裁定上訴期間暫停執行
findings.excerpt: In 2024, the CNMC imposed a fine and restricted certain of Booking.com's business practices such as those relating to contractual parity provisions and the ranking criteria; it recorded a liability for this matter with $ 476million.

findings.claim: 義大利 AGCM 2026 年 4 月對 Booking.com 啟動調查（付費能見度／偏好夥伴排名）；瑞士 2025 年命令降低佣金、上訴中；希臘 2025 年 6 月啟動正式調查
findings.excerpt: In April 2026, the Italian Competition and Consumer Authority opened an investigation into whether certain Booking.com business practices adversely affect consumers.

findings.claim: 經查搜尋結果未見美國 DOJ／FTC 對 Booking 的反壟斷（非消費者保護）案件；一手 10-K Item 3 摘錄無具體條文
findings.source: WebSearch 結果（無美國反壟斷案）

regulatory_antitrust.note: 另有未核實：德文報導稱歐盟執委會 2026-10-21 對 Booking.com 啟動詐欺防制調查；MLex 稱希臘異議聲明 2026 年 10 月底、救濟措施 12 月 28 日聽證；Booking/Etraveli 歐盟法院裁決日期矛盾，皆未核到一手來源。

clues.claim: 希臘競爭委員會就 Booking 濫用優勢地位案，異議聲明與救濟措施聽證（12/28）
歐盟執委會調查 Booking.com 詐欺防制（德文報導，未核實）
